purpose: Fourth non-overlapping BTC/USDT experiment with a mechanism distinct from SMA crossover, trend+momentum, z-score reversion, RSI regime-aware and Donchian/ATR breakout. Registered before fetching any 2020 data or observing any 2020 result. No grid search and no parameter derived from windows 1-3.

data.non_overlap: 2020-12-30 < 2022-01-01 (v3) < 2024-01-01 (v2) < 2025-11-27 (v1); no shared bar with any prior experiment
data.freshness_rule: Report retrieved_at, dataset_end and age at evaluation. Historical windows are intentionally old; freshness is provenance, not a live-data claim. If integrity checks fail, STOP.

criteria.note: Identical to registries v1-v3; no threshold is changed.

cost_assumptions.note: Same effective cost as validation-v1's 7.5 fee + 7.5 slippage; spread is explicit.

hypothesis.name: Opening-price continuation with bullish confirmation and two-bar time exit
hypothesis.market_rationale: At the 00:00 UTC daily boundary of a continuous crypto market, a large move from the prior close to the opening print plus a bullish bar can reflect a liquidity reset followed by continuation. This mechanism uses the relationship between the prior close, the current open and the current close — never high/low channels, moving averages, oscillators or true range. It is therefore substantively different from every prior experiment (SMA cross, trend+momentum, z-score reversion, RSI regime-aware, Donchian/ATR breakout). A strict two-bar maximum holding period prevents dead exposure.
indicators: bullish confirmation from close versus open of the same bar
hypothesis.entry_rule: At bar i, using only bars up to i-1: if (open[i-1]/close[i-2] - 1) >= 0.005 and close[i-1] > open[i-1], enter at bar i open.
hypothesis.exit_rule: While long, evaluate at bar i-1: exit at bar i open if close[i-1] < open[i-1] (bearish bar) or bars_held >= 2. Inherited 10% hard stop and 30% portfolio drawdown kill switch remain active.
hypothesis.risk_management: two-bar time exit, bearish-bar exit, 10% hard stop, 30% drawdown kill switch, position fraction 1.0, costs on every position change
hypothesis.parameter_origin: 0.5% opening move and two-bar holding are chosen a priori as a conservative, simple rule before any 2020 data was fetched; NOT derived from exp-01..exp-08 results. Exactly one configuration; NO grid search and NO curve fitting.

execution_procedure: Fetch 365 daily BTCUSDT bars with startTime=1577836800000 and verify integrity/freshness report
Run one fixed configuration through unchanged validation.py (train/validation/OOS + walk-forward)
Generate quant-report.v1 with provenance, costs, metrics and limitations
Run independent verify_report.py and repeat the run to confirm deterministic metrics
Record result as REJECTED or VALIDATION CANDIDATE under unchanged criteria
decision_rule: promote_candidate only if accepted_for_paper_candidate is true AND benchmarks are reported honestly. Even then, paper ledger requires separate BOS approval. If rejected, record failure and evidence-based cause; do not relax criteria or re-run with different parameters.
